title: UEFA European Performance Spots (Race for 5th Champions League Spot)
description: The two domestic associations whose clubs earn the highest average UEFA coefficient points this season receive an extra automatic Champions League league-phase berth for the 2027/28 campaign.

standings.analysis: Premier League clubs have gone undefeated across 18 group stage ties in all three UEFA competitions, accumulating dominant coefficient dividends.
Strong showings from Inter, Napoli, and Roma maintain Italy's narrow advantage over Spain for the second European Performance Spot.
Real Madrid and Barcelona are driving high points, but Real Betis and Villarreal must advance deep in the knockouts to bridge the 0.725 gap to Italy.
RB Leipzig's early struggles have depressed the German association average point yield despite Bayern Munich's stellar campaign.
Divided by 7 entries, French losses in early qualifying rounds leave Ligue 1 requiring a near-miraculous European run to enter contention.
